author: GitHub
description:
Building software on GitHub means navigating tiny details every single day. In this clip from the GitHub Podcast, Cassidy Williams highlights the GitHub Tiny Wins team, a group dedicated to fixing small platform frictions and paper cuts for maintainers. From site performance tweaks to making contributing guidelines accessible right in the repository sidebar, small details make a massive impact.
